items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Usually in those days the sheet music had piano solos; you know, Zes(?) Coffrey.

ctx.x: When were you first conscious of Earl Hines then?
Well, there was a composer... Usually in those days the sheet music had piano solos; you know, Zes(?) Coffrey.
Oh yes. That was sort of "Intermezzo" time.
